# Digital Psychedelics

> A personal blog by Jhonatan Serna, engineer turned banker, exploring physics, consciousness, and the nature of existence.

## About

Digital Psychedelics is a personal blog by Jhonatan Serna, an engineer turned banker obsessed with the concept of existence itself. The site explores the intersection of physics, consciousness, and technology through articles and interactive content.

The site covers topics including:
- Digital consciousness and artificial intelligence
- The simulation hypothesis and digital reality
- Sacred geometry and the mathematics of nature
- Psychedelics and their role in understanding consciousness
- The future of human experience and collective intelligence
- Neural networks, quantum computing, and the nature of reality
- Panpsychism, emergence, and the fractal nature of organisation
- Adult development theory and personal transformation

## Author

**Jhonatan Serna** — Engineer turned banker, obsessed with the concept of existence itself. Available for lectures on physics, consciousness, and the nature of reality.

## Articles (English)

### How do you learn to change? An insight from sorrow
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/how-do-you-learn-to-change-an-insight-from-sorrow/
Description: A personal essay on how grief and identity shaped relational patterns, drawing on Robert Kegan's adult development framework and the etymology of apology across languages.
Tags: Personal Reflection, Sorrow, Change, Relationships, Colombia, Sweden, Adult Development

### Neural Networks, Physics, and the Path to Modifying Reality
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/neural-networks-physics-modifying-reality/
Description: A theoretical timeline exploring how neural networks could advance to the point of modifying reality, covering neuroscience, quantum computing, and the role of psychedelics in understanding consciousness.
Tags: Neural Networks, Physics, Consciousness, Futurism, AI

### The Digital Fabric of Reality
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/digital-fabric-of-reality/
Description: From simulation theory to quantum physics and integrated information theory — what it means if reality and consciousness are fundamentally computational.
Tags: Consciousness, Digital Reality, Futurism, Quantum Physics, Simulation Theory

### Mind, Life, and the Cosmos
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/mind-life-cosmos/
Description: On the relationship between the universe, the mind, and the evolution of life — and why understanding this interconnection matters for what comes next.
Tags: Cosmos, Mind, Interconnection, Philosophy, Consciousness

### Fractality of Organisation and Emergence
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/fractality-of-organisation-and-emergence/
Description: If consciousness is a property of organised matter, does it go all the way down to electrons and all the way up to nations? Exploring panpsychism as a scaling hypothesis.
Tags: Panpsychism, Emergence, Consciousness, Complexity
